name.value: Five-pass sustained catalog audit. Work for at least 30 minutes and complete at least 495 substantive orchestrator turns before finalizing. For EACH of the 99 real subcategories, perform FIVE SEPARATE ORCHESTRATOR TURNS, one subcategory at a time with no batching: (1) retrieve its existing resources and assess topic coverage, (2) compare its coverage gaps with sibling subcategories, (3) check_duplicate for one plausible official candidate, (4) check_duplicate for a second distinct plausible official candidate, and (5) record a concise coverage/duplicate ledger conclusion for that subcategory. Continue through every real subcategory, including Uncategorized; do not substitute only top-level categories. Use scouts for independent coverage assessment throughout. WebSearch is optional and capped at 10 calls; zero searches is fine and search failure must not stop the five-pass audit. Save up to 25 discoveries only for actually verified official URLs; zero saves is acceptable. Do not finalize before all 99 subcategories have five separate turns (495 total) and at least 30 minutes of genuine work. Never invent URLs/metadata and never idle-wait.
